Footer.module.css plate = color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 85%, var(--color-text)) paired with on-primary, full-opacity social links. Could not frame a clean painted screenshot: styles/base.css .redgate-main has min-height: calc(100vh - 200px), a sticky-footer pattern; in tall capture windows main stretches to (window-200) and parks the footer at the very bottom edge behind the fixed cookie banner. This is an INFRA/capture-geometry limitation (footer sits directly after content in a real browser at normal viewport heights), not a component failure.
